$comment: Gisik Nokma on Apple HIG. Source of truth for the CODE remains
packages/ui/src/tokens.ts; this file is the design-side statement of what that
file would become, and every number is reproducible with docs/hig-probe-accessible.py.
Values are Apple's INCREASED-CONTRAST system colors. Apple's stock palette fails 15
of the 27 pairs declared in tokens.ts (white on stock systemBlue is 4.02:1 — Apple
does not target WCAG AA for control fills); these fail none.
ONE VALUE IS NOT APPLE'S: textMuted's 0.80 opacity is a reconstruction of Apple's
increased-contrast secondaryLabel, not a citation. Every hex below is a real Apple value.

rulings.R1: Borders dropped. No HIG separator clears WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 on any light background (opaqueSeparator #C6C6C8 measures 1.53 / 1.71 / 1.36 against surface / raised / sunken). Separation is carried by fill. The `border` and `borderStrong` roles survive as FILL values, not stroke values.
rulings.R2: iOS metrics. Body 17 clears the product's committed 16px body floor. Caption is clamped to 12px rather than HIG's 11pt so the 12px label ratchet in apps/web/e2e-viewport/type-scale-baseline.json holds.

fill.$comment: Apple's system fills. These are what R1 replaced every border with.

type.$comment: iOS ramp. Caption clamped to 12 (HIG says 11) — see R2.
type.family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', system-ui, sans-serif

radius.$comment: Twelve ad-hoc values in ui.css collapse to four.

target.$comment: Unchanged — HIG's 44pt is already this product's stated floor. Dense in-list rows keep the 24px WCAG 2.5.8 floor, which is the product's own existing split.

measuredPairs.$comment: Every pair declared in packages/ui/src/tokens.ts CONTRAST_PAIRS, light / dark, on the values above. 27 of 27 pass. Re-run docs/hig-probe-accessible.py to check.

newPairsToDeclare.$comment: CONTRAST_PAIRS declares no border and no focusRing pair — the gap that let 17 of 24 bordered classes reach 3:1-failing values with the build green. Adopting this palette should add these two rows in the same change.
